$comment: How a driver command's script is run, by what it is (ADR-001 amendment 12): `match` globs on the script's file name; `argv` the command line, `{script}` the script, `{operands}` the operands, `{bash}` / `{python}` / `{pwsh}` the interpreters the CLI finds; `inSession` runs a PowerShell script in the CLI's own session, its -Name operands bound to the parameters it declares. A host adds or overrides one in its manifest (`runtimes`); a command may name its runtime outright ({script, runtime}).
